From determining positioning, naming, competitive analysis, feature prioritization and external communications, you help shape the product and help it grow a consumer base. This means you work with a cross-functional team across Sales, corporate communications, legal, webmasters, product development, engineering and more. In this role, you'll be involved with product marketing strategy from beginning to end.As the Senior Scaled Growth & Content (SGC) Lead, you will define the content agenda and guide a team of writers and AI specialists to produce high-quality B2B content, owning the editorial lifecycle from conception to global scale. As a player-coach, you will orchestrate the content development process, accelerating production while leveraging the latest advancements in AI to experiment with cutting-edge formats and topics.Crucially, you will lead audience acquisition and growth tactics to scale subscribers within our target audience. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. role: Director, Site Strategy and Programs, ITC
normalizedText: Who You’ll Work WithYou will work closely with the India Technology Center (ITC) Site Leader and senior leadership team, partnering across functions including Technology, Finance, Places and Services, HR & TA, Legal, and Enterprise Operations. This role will report to the India Site Leader & will work closely within leadership ecosystem, connecting global enterprise priorities with local execution. You will act as a strategic advisor to senior leaders, working across a highly matrixed, global environment to enable alignment, accelerate decision-making, and drive large- scale initiatives.Who We Are Looking ForWe are looking for a high-impact strategy leader with strong executive presence, structured thinking, and the ability to operate at both strategic and execution levels. This is a role for someone who is equally comfortable shaping long-term strategy and driving delivery in a complex, fast-evolving environment. The ideal candidate brings experience from leading consulting firms, corporate strategy teams, or transformation roles within global organizations or GCCs. They are skilled at working with senior stakeholders, influencing without authority, and simplifying complex problems into clear, actionable plans. They combine strong problem-solving with business judgment, and are known for driving outcomes—aligning teams, making trade-offs, and ensuring follow- through. This role requires someone who is curious, pragmatic, and motivated by building and scaling high-impact organizations.Key Qualification15+ years of experience in strategy, consulting, business operations, transformation, or Chief of Staff roles.Experience in global enterprises, GCCs, or large-scale technology organizations preferred - MBA or equivalent from a leading institution preferred. Proven experience working directly with senior leadership and influencing strategic decisions - Strong capabilities in strategic planning, governance, and cross-functional executionWhat You’ll Work OnYou will lead the strategy and transformation agenda for one of Nike’s fastest- growing technology centers, working closely with leadership to define priorities, strengthen operating rhythms, and deliver initiatives that shape the site’s future and enterprise impact.Your ResponsibilityShape and drive the multi-year strategy for the India Technology Center, aligning site priorities with global business goals.Partner with senior leadership to define vision, strategic priorities, and investment choices for site growth and capability building.Lead planning cycles (annual and quarterly), ensuring focus on high-impact initiatives and measurable outcomes - Establish and run governance forums, leadership cadences, and decision.making frameworks to improve clarity and execution.Develop executive-level presentations, strategic narratives, and leadership communications for global stakeholders.Build insights through benchmarking, market intelligence, and internal data to inform strategic decisions.Work cross-functionally to drive alignment, remove execution barriers, and accelerate delivery across key initiatives. Marketing and Communication Lead Navitas is seeking a dynamic and results-driven, Marketing & Communications Lead for one of its university partners, Western Sydney University. This role will be responsible for leading the development and execution of integrated marketing, communications, and brand strategies to support the successful launch and continued growth of Western Sydney University's Greater Noida campus Working closely with teams across India and Australia, the successful candidate will drive brand awareness, student recruitment, stakeholder engagement, and institutional reputation through innovative marketing campaigns, media engagement, digital marketing, content creation, and strategic partnership initiatives. This is a hands-on opportunity for a proactive self-starter who thrives in a dynamic environment, can work independently, effectively manage external agencies, and build strong relationships across media, education, and industry networks. Key Responsibilities: Marketing Strategy & CampaignsDevelop and execute annual marketing plans aligned to student recruitment and brand objectives.Plan and deliver integrated campaigns across digital, social, search, media, events, and partnerships.Manage campaign performance, reporting, and optimisation.Support student recruitment activities and lead generation initiatives. Digital Marketing & PerformanceManage paid media campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, and local Indian channels.Oversee SEO, website performance, and digital content strategy.Monitor campaign KPIs, including leads, conversions, CPL, and ROI.Work with external agencies to optimise performance and audience targeting. Media & Public RelationsDevelop relationships with media outlets, journalists, and education publications.Coordinate media opportunities, interviews, press releases, and announcements.Manage local PR agency relationships.Identify opportunities to position Western Sydney University as a leading international education provider in India. Content & CommunicationsDevelop compelling content showcasing student outcomes, industry partnerships, and campus developments.Coordinate the production of videos, case studies, social content, and thought leadership.Ensure messaging aligns with global brand standards and local market needs. Partnerships & Stakeholder EngagementSupport engagement with schools, pathway partners, government stakeholders, and industry organisations.Assist with launch events, recruitment activities, and partnership initiatives.Work closely with recruitment teams to ensure marketing activities support enrolment targets. Brand ManagementEstablish and maintain Western Sydney University's brand presence in India.Ensure consistent application of brand guidelines across all channels.Monitor competitor activity and market trends. Essential Experience6+ years of experience in marketing, communications, or student recruitment marketing.Proven experience developing and executing integrated marketing campaigns.Strong experience in digital marketing and paid media campaign management.Experience managing external agencies and third-party vendors.Demonstrated experience managing marketing budgets, campaign performance, and reporting. KnowledgeStrong understanding of the Indian higher education sector.Knowledge of student recruitment marketing and the prospective student journey.Sound understanding of media relations and public relations practices in India. SkillsExcellent stakeholder management, interpersonal, and communication skills.Strong project management and organisational capabilities.Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced, start-up environment.Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving skills. DesirableExperience working within a university, international education provider, pathway provider, or education agency.Experience supporting the launch of a new brand, campus, or education venture.Established network of digital media, creative, PR, and production partners within India. Key Relationships: Reporting to: Marketing Manager, International (based in Australia)This position supervises: NIL Internal StakeholdersInternational Recruitment TeamFuture Students Marketing & Communications TeamLaunchPad TeamGlobal Partnerships TeamGlobal Mobility TeamAdmissions TeamDigital Marketing TeamUniversity Communications & Media TeamIndia Campus Leadership TeamAcademic and Professional Staff supporting India operations External StakeholdersMedia and PR AgenciesCreative and Digital AgenciesMedia Organisations and JournalistsEducation Agents and Recruitment PartnersIndustry and Corporate PartnersGovernment and Regulatory BodiesAlumni and Student Ambassadors Key ChallengesBuilding awareness and establishing the Western Sydney University India campus in a highly competitive higher education market.Delivering integrated marketing and communications campaigns while collaborating with cross-functional teams across India and Australia.Balancing immediate student recruitment objectives with long-term brand growth, reputation, and stakeholder engagement.Thriving in a fast-paced start-up environment where systems, processes, partnerships, and brand presence are continually evolving. University Expectations: The University expects all employees to be aware of, and comply with, relevant legislation and Western Sydney University's policies and procedures applicable to their role, including but not limited to:Code of ConductWork Health and Safety and Wellbeing Management SystemEnterprise Agreement or AwardAnti-discrimination principles, Equal Employment Opportunity, and staff and student equity About NavitasNavitas is a leading global education provider supporting more than 60,000 students each year through innovative, life-changing learning opportunities around the world. You'll be part of a purpose-driven organisation where your work directly contributes to helping learners achieve their goals. How to ApplyShape the future of international education. Join us as a Marketing & Communications Lead and drive impactful marketing, communications, and brand strategies that support the launch and growth of Western Sydney University's Greater Noida campus. Apply online via www.navitas.com/careers. Applications will close on 15 July 2026. Early applications are encouraged, as we may appoint before the closing date. Applicants must have full working rights in India and be available to start immediately or on short notice. By applying, you agree to Navitas' Privacy Policy. Who we are The NS Raghavan Centre for Entrepreneurial Learning (NSRCEL) is IIM Bangalore’s startup hub and incubation centre. The centre is structured as a section-8 not-for-profit entity. NSRCEL’s mission is to support ventures in the start-up ecosystem that demonstrate potential to create significant economic and societal impact. This financial year alone NSRCEL has engaged with 662 ventures through 13 unique program tracks across 82 townsin the country.NSRCEL is supported by the Department of Science and Technology (DST) and Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) and foundations like Pernod Ricard India Foundation and SBI Foundation. NSRCEL has partnered with corporates like Alstom,Capgemini, Unilever, Kotak Mahindra Bank and Maruti Suzuki among others.Background to the role:NSRCEL has been focussed until now on early-revenue stage incubation, helping founders navigate from MVP to PMF. Many of our founders come back when they are confident of their PMF, in seeking assistance to now create break-out growth. We realise that the founder and organizational capability to reach PMF is very different from the ability required to create break-out growth. We have experimented with this need in small ways through the FintechCoE, a circularity track pilot in partnership with Acumen, and a women-in-tech scale-up sub-track.NSRCEL is now creating a growth-stage track to address this. The objective is to help put these ventures on a 5x growth path in 3 years. The track will focus on growth stage ventures that have already achieved PMF, operational stability and early capital infusion. Some of the entry criteria for the track may be:• Rs 10 Cr+ or $ 6Mn in ARR• Pre-series A funded• Tech-enabled or tech-embedded• Operating in high-growth marketsThe responsibilities will:• Lead the ongoing Fintech CoE• Design and roll out a sector-inclusive growth stage accelerator• Design and implement track variants for women entrepreneurs and social impact enterprises• Track and deliver to impact outcomesWhat you will be doingThe role will conceptualize, design, and execute the Growth Stage Accelerator.This will include: Defining the thesis and quantified outcomes of the track Creating and owning the design and execution from outreach and cohort selection to venture & founder outcomes Securing resources, partners, mentors, experts to ensure desired results Creating and owning the revenue and financial plan for the track As part of the leadership team of NSRCEL you will play an important role in shaping strategic decisions for the centre and will serve as a spokesperson for the organization. About BNP Paribas GroupBNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.About BNP Paribas India SolutionsEstablished in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.Commitment to Diversity and InclusionAt BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. Chat Operations Manager is responsible for leading and optimizing the performance of customer service team focused on chat interactions. This role drives the achievement of key digital customer service indicators (KPIs), ensures efficient handling of chat volumes, and maintains a consistently high-quality customer experience across all chat channels. The manager will lead, develop, and mentor their agents, implement strategic initiatives for chat operations, and foster a culture of digital excellence and continuous improvement.Key Responsibilities:Operational Leadership: Oversee the daily operations of customer service team, ensuring optimal staffing, efficient chat queue management, and adherence to digital communication policies and procedures.Performance Management: Establish, monitor, and achieve critical chat-specific customer service KPIs, including Average Response Time (ART), Concurrent Chat Handling, Chat Abandonment Rate, Quality Assurance (QA) scores for written interactions, and First Contact Resolution (FCR) in digital channels. Develop and implement strategies to enhance these metrics.Team Development & Coaching: Lead, coach, and mentor team members focusing on effective written communication, tone, multi-tasking skills in a chat environment, and efficient use of chat tools and resources. Conduct regular performance reviews and identify development opportunities.Strategy & Planning: Contribute to the strategic development and execution of digital customer service initiatives, including integrating new chat technologies, optimizing chat flows, and exploring AI/chatbot synergies to improve efficiency and customer experience.Process Improvement: Identify areas for improvement within chat operations, implement best practices for digital engagement, streamline chat processes (e.g., template usage, knowledge base integration), and reduce resolution times. Drive continuous improvement based on data analysis and customer feedback.Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Workforce Management, Technology, Bot team and Quality Assurance to ensure seamless integration of chat channels and alignment with overall business goals.Reporting & Analysis: Analyze chat interaction data, generate comprehensive reports on team performance, chat trends, and bot performance. Provide actionable insights and recommendations to senior management for strategic decision-making.Issue Resolution: Serve as an escalation point for complex or sensitive customer issues encountered via chat, ensuring timely and effective resolution while upholding service standards.Compliance & Risk Management: Ensure all chat operations comply with internal policies, industry regulations, and legal requirements pertaining to digital communication and data privacy. Identify and mitigate potential operational risksProjects & Initiatives: Lead and participate in various projects and initiatives aimed at enhancing the chat platform, introducing new features, improving agent tools, or integrating with other digital channels to elevate the overall digital customer experience.Qualifications:Education: Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience. Master's degree preferred.Experience: Minimum of 10+ years of progressive experience in customer service operations, with at least 6+ years in a leadership role managing customer service team (people manager)Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment and manage multiple digital priorities effectively.Leadership Skills: Strong leadership, motivational, and coaching abilities, with a track record of developing high-performing teams in a digital context.Analytical Skills: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret digital interaction data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.Communication: Exceptional written communication skills, with a keen understanding of digital communication etiquette, brand voice, and clarity. Strong verbal communication for internal leadership.Technical Proficiency: Proficient in chat management systems, knowledge base systems, and familiarity with AI/chatbot technologies. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.Desired Attributes:Strategic thinker with an ability to anticipate future trends in digital customer service.Proactive and results-oriented with a strong sense of ownership over digital channels.Ability to inspire and influence others towards achieving digital excellence.High level of integrity and professionalism.------------------------------------------------------Job Family Group: Operations - Core------------------------------------------------------Job Family:Operations Support------------------------------------------------------Time Type:------------------------------------------------------Most Relevant SkillsPlease see the requirements listed above.------------------------------------------------------Other Relevant SkillsFor complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter.------------------------------------------------------Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law.If you are a person with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation to use our search tools and/or apply for a career opportunity review Accessibility at Citi.View Citi’s EEO Policy Statement and the Know Your Rights poster. normalizedText: Leading at CognizantThis is a Leadership role at Cognizant. We believe how you lead is as important as what you deliver. Cognizant leaders at every level: Drive our business strategy and inspire teams around our future. Live the leadership behaviors, leading themselves, others and the business. Uphold our Values, role modeling them in every action and decision. Nurture our people and culture, creating a workplace where all can thrive.At Cognizant, leadership transcends titles and is embodied in actions and behaviors. We empower our leaders at every level to drive business strategy, inspire teams, uphold our values, and foster an inclusive culture.The RoleCognizant helps companies modernize technology, reimagine processes and transform experiences so they stay ahead in a fast-changing world.Our Cognizant consulting group is looking for a Head of India Tech Consulting & Strategic Deals to join our journey. Our solutions are in demand and we’re passionate about making a difference. Job Description – Head – Customer ExperienceLocation: Andheri West, MumbaiExperience: 15+ YearsIndustry Preference: Real Estate preferred---Role PurposeThe Head – Customer Experience will be responsible for driving the overall customer experience strategy across the customer lifecycle, with a strong focus on Net Promoter Score (NPS), Voice of Customer (VOC), customer journey enhancement, service excellence, and service recovery. The role will lead the design and implementation of customer feedback mechanisms, monitor customer sentiment across touchpoints, drive closure of escalations, and partner with cross-functional teams to improve customer satisfaction, loyalty, and brand advocacy.The incumbent will play a strategic role in building a customer-first culture across the organization by leveraging insights, strengthening governance, improving processes, and ensuring a seamless experience from booking to possession and post-possession.---Key Responsibilities1. Customer Experience Strategy- Lead the overall customer experience agenda for the organization across the real estate customer lifecycle.- Define and drive the customer experience roadmap aligned with business objectives and brand promise.- Build and strengthen a customer-centric culture by embedding customer experience principles across functions and projects.- Establish service standards, customer engagement practices, and experience benchmarks across all customer touchpoints.- Identify opportunities to enhance customer delight, loyalty, retention, and advocacy.2. NPS & Voice of Customer (VOC) Management- Own and drive the NPS framework across key customer touchpoints such as booking, agreement, collections, construction updates, possession, handover, and post-possession.- Design and institutionalize customer listening mechanisms including NPS surveys, feedback programs, VOC interventions, and satisfaction studies.- Monitor customer sentiment, identify promoters, passives, and detractors, and ensure structured action planning and closure.- Analyze customer feedback trends, service gaps, recurring pain points, and root causes to derive actionable business insights.- Build project-wise and function-wise customer feedback reporting and ensure regular review with leadership.3. Customer Journey Mapping & Experience Improvement- Map the end-to-end customer journey and identify gaps across communication, documentation, collections, project updates, possession, and post-sales interactions.- Design and drive customer journey improvement initiatives to ensure a seamless and differentiated customer experience.- Improve consistency, responsiveness, transparency, and ease of interaction across all customer-facing processes.- Partner with internal teams to simplify and strengthen customer touchpoints and service delivery standards.- Lead initiatives to improve customer communication quality, turnaround times, and service responsiveness.4. Detractor Management & Service Recovery- Ensure timely closure of detractor cases, customer escalations, and service-related concerns emerging through NPS and other feedback channels.- Lead structured service recovery for dissatisfied customers and track effectiveness of resolution actions.- Review critical complaints and escalations and ensure closure through collaboration with CRM, Sales, Projects, Legal, Accounts, Collections, and Site teams.- Drive root-cause analysis of customer complaints and implement preventive and corrective actions to reduce recurrence.- Ensure closure communication is timely, professional, and aligned with customer expectations.5. Governance, Reporting & Analytics- Establish governance mechanisms for regular review of NPS, VOC, customer complaints, service gaps, and improvement initiatives.- Publish monthly / quarterly dashboards covering NPS scores, detractor trends, VOC insights, complaint categories, closure timelines, and service improvement actions.- Present customer experience insights, risk areas, and recommendations to senior leadership and management forums.- Use customer data and feedback analytics to influence process changes, policy improvements, and service interventions.- Monitor key service metrics and ensure performance against defined customer experience KPIs.6. Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management- Work closely with Sales, CRM, Projects, Legal, Accounts, Collections, Marketing, Facility Management, and Site teams to improve customer experience across the lifecycle.- Act as a central point of leadership for customer experience transformation initiatives across departments.- Influence internal stakeholders to adopt customer-first practices and improve service delivery standards.- Ensure customer concerns are addressed proactively and escalations are resolved with accountability and ownership.- Support leadership in driving customer-centric decision-making across business functions.7. Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement- Identify recurring pain points and service bottlenecks and drive process improvements to enhance customer satisfaction.- Review customer-facing SOPs, communication practices, escalation matrices, and service protocols to ensure effectiveness and consistency.- Drive standardization of customer experience practices across projects and teams.- Recommend automation, digital interventions, and process enhancements to improve customer engagement and experience monitoring.- Build a robust feedback-to-action framework to ensure VOC insights translate into measurable improvements.8. Team Leadership- Lead and mentor the Customer Experience / NPS / VOC team and build capability within the function.- Define team KRAs, monitor performance, and ensure strong execution of feedback, analytics, and service recovery processes.- Create a culture of ownership, responsiveness, and customer empathy within the team.- Guide team members on handling escalations, customer interactions, reporting, and stakeholder coordination.---Key Deliverables / KRAs- Improvement in overall NPS score and customer satisfaction across projects and touchpoints- Strong VOC coverage with actionable insights and closure mechanisms- Effective closure of detractor cases and escalations within defined timelines- Reduction in repeat complaints and recurring customer pain points- Implementation of customer journey and process improvement initiatives- Strengthening of service governance, customer communication, and experience standards- Enhanced customer retention, loyalty, and brand advocacy- Development of a customer-first service culture across the organization---Desired Candidate Profile- 15+ years of experience in Customer Experience / NPS / VOC / CRM / Customer Satisfaction / Service Excellence- Prior experience in Real Estate is strongly preferred- Proven track record of building and driving customer experience strategy, NPS frameworks, and VOC programs at an organizational level- Strong understanding of customer journey mapping, service recovery, complaint management, and customer lifecycle management- Experience in handling senior-level customer escalations and driving cross-functional service improvements- Strong analytical orientation with the ability to convert feedback into business insights and process interventions- Excellent stakeholder management, communication, presentation, and leadership skills- Strong customer-first mindset with the ability to influence teams and drive organizational change- Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, CRM systems, dashboards, and reporting tools---Educational Qualification- Graduate in any discipline- MBA / Postgraduate preferred---Key Competencies- Customer Centricity- Strategic Thinking- Service Excellence Orientation- Stakeholder Management- Problem Solving & Decision Making- Analytical Thinking- Process Improvement- Team Leadership- Communication & Influencing Skills- Escalation & Service Recovery normalizedText: This role may also be located in our Playa Vista, CA campus.Applicants in the County of Los Angeles: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Dublin, Ireland; Gurugram, Haryana, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India; London, UK; Atlanta, GA, USA; Chicago, IL, USA; New York, NY, USA; Los Angeles, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA.Minimum qualifications:Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.8 years of experience in management consulting, sales operations, business strategy, investment banking, venture capital, private equity, or corporate advisory, or 6 years of experience with an advanced degree.Preferred qualifications:Experience in project or program management, process improvements, business analysis.Experience managing executive stakeholders, leading organization level strategic initiatives, and running business operations.Experience in managing major strategic and operational projects across Ads verticals.About The JobgTech Ads is responsible for all support and media and technical services for customers big and small across our entire Ad products stack. We help our customers get the most out of our Ad and Publisher products and guide them when they need help. We provide a range of services from enabling better self help and in-product support, to providing better support through interactions, setting up accounts and implementing ad campaigns, and providing media solutions for customers business and marketing needs and providing complex technical and measurement solutions along with consultative support for our large customers. Chief Operating Officer (COO) – Women Empowerment & Education Location: Mulund, MumbaiTravel: Pan-India travel requiredSector Preference: Development / NGO sector experience preferred About the Role We are seeking an experienced, visionary, and mission-driven Chief Operating Officer (COO) to lead the operational strategy and execution of our Women Empowerment & Education vertical. The COO will be responsible for driving organizational growth, ensuring effective program implementation, managing financial performance, and building sustainable systems that create measurable social impact. This role requires a dynamic leader who can balance program excellence with financial discipline, including managing Profit & Loss (P&L), while scaling women empowerment and education initiatives across India. Key ResponsibilitiesStrategic Leadership Develop and execute operational strategies aligned with the organization's mission of empowering women through education, skill development, livelihood generation, and social inclusion. Collaborate with the leadership team to expand programs, partnerships, and nationwide impact. Identify opportunities for innovation, growth, and operational excellence. Operational Management Oversee the day-to-day operations of the Women Empowerment & Education vertical. Ensure seamless execution of education, vocational training, entrepreneurship, community development, and capacity-building programs. Design and implement SOPs, operational frameworks, and scalable systems to improve efficiency and impact. Financial Management Manage the Profit & Loss (P&L) of the vertical, ensuring financial sustainability and effective resource utilization. Lead budgeting, financial planning, forecasting, and performance monitoring. Strengthen revenue streams through grants, CSR partnerships, institutional funding, and strategic collaborations. Team Leadership Lead, mentor, and manage cross-functional teams across multiple locations. Foster a high-performance, inclusive, and mission-driven work culture. Develop leadership capabilities and strengthen team engagement. Partnerships & Stakeholder Management Build and maintain strategic partnerships with government agencies, educational institutions, NGOs, CSR partners, donors, foundations, and corporate stakeholders. Represent the organization at national forums, conferences, and key stakeholder meetings. Drive collaborations that enhance program reach and sustainability. Compliance & Governance Ensure compliance with statutory regulations, NGO governance standards, and funding requirements. Establish transparent reporting mechanisms and impact measurement frameworks to track program effectiveness and organizational performance. Candidate Profile Experience: 10–20 years in leadership roles, preferably within NGOs, development organizations, social enterprises, educational institutions, or mission-driven organizations. Proven experience in managing Profit & Loss (P&L) for a business unit, program, or vertical. Strong expertise in operations management, financial planning, strategic execution, and organizational development. Demonstrated experience in scaling programs across multiple locations. Prior experience in women empowerment, education, skill development, livelihood initiatives, or community development will be a strong advantage. Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and strategic thinking abilities. Education Master's degree in Management, Public Policy, Social Work, Development Studies, Education, Business Administration, or a related field preferred. normalizedText: Location: Remote (India) Travel: 5–10% (Customer meetings, conferences, and partner events) Employment Type: Full-time About Vikara Vikara is an AI implementation and advisory firm that helps organizations turn AI into measurable business outcomes. We partner with companies to identify where AI can create the greatest impact, design practical AI strategies, and implement production-ready AI solutions that improve revenue, customer experience, productivity, and operational efficiency. Our expertise spans AI strategy, agentic AI, voice AI, AI-powered automation, enterprise AI adoption, and custom AI applications across industries including healthcare, life sciences, retail, manufacturing, financial services, and professional services. We’re building a global business and are looking for a highly entrepreneurial GTM leader to help us acquire customers across the US, Europe, and APAC. About the Role This is not a traditional sales role. We’re looking for a builder—someone who enjoys creating opportunities, opening doors, developing relationships, and closing business in fast-moving markets. As our Founding GTM Lead, you’ll work directly with the founder to build Vikara’s global customer acquisition engine. Your primary focus will be acquiring small and mid-sized businesses (SMBs), while supporting selective enterprise opportunities. This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys wearing multiple hats and wants to play a meaningful role in shaping the growth of an AI-first company. What You’ll Do Own New Customer Acquisition Drive the complete sales process from prospecting through closing. Identify and engage prospective customers across the US, Europe, and APAC Conduct discovery conversations with founders, executives, and business leaders Understand customer challenges and position Vikara’s AI advisory and implementation services Prepare proposals and commercial agreements Negotiate and close new business Maintain a healthy and predictable sales pipeline Build a Repeatable Outbound Engine Design and execute outbound growth programs using modern sales techniques and AI-powered tools. Channels include: LinkedIn Personalized email campaigns AI-assisted prospecting Founder-led outreach Referrals Virtual events and webinars Industry communities Strategic networking Continuously refine messaging, targeting, and conversion rates. Develop Strategic Partnerships Build relationships with organizations that can create long-term growth opportunities. Examples include: Technology partners AI platform companies Cloud providers Industry associations Startup ecosystems Venture Capital and Private Equity firms Regional consulting partners Help Shape Our Go-to-Market Strategy Work closely with the founder to continuously improve: Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) Industry focus Service packaging Pricing strategy Messaging Sales playbooks Customer acquisition strategy Represent Vikara Help build Vikara’s reputation by participating in: Industry conferences Customer meetings Executive roundtables Webinars Community events Travel will typically be limited to 5–10%. Who You Are You enjoy creating opportunities from scratch. You don’t wait for leads—you create them. You are naturally curious, commercially driven, and excited about how AI is transforming businesses. You thrive in fast-moving environments where initiative matters more than hierarchy. What We’re Looking For Required 5–10 years of experience in Business Development, Enterprise Sales, Partnerships, or Go-to-Market roles Proven experience selling technology, SaaS, consulting, cloud, or AI solutions Experience selling into US and/or international markets Excellent written and verbal English communication skills Strong consultative selling and relationship-building skills Comfortable engaging founders, CXOs, and senior business leaders Experience managing a CRM and sales pipeline Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely Preferred Experience in one or more of the following: Artificial Intelligence Data & Analytics Cloud Technologies Digital Transformation Enterprise Software Management Consulting Regulated Industry Experience selling into SMBs is highly preferred. An existing network within technology companies, startups, consulting firms, or industry ecosystems is a strong advantage. Experience using modern GTM tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, HubSpot, Clay, or AI-powered sales tools is a plus. Build the GTM function from the ground up Work directly with the founder and leadership team Sell cutting-edge AI solutions with real business impact Engage with customers across the US, Europe, and APAC Shape the future of an ambitious, fast-growing AI company Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives Significant opportunity for career growth as the company scales If This Sounds Like You… If you’re excited about helping businesses unlock the value of AI, enjoy building relationships across global markets, and want to be part of creating something meaningful from the ground up, we’d love to hear from you. Apply with your resume and a brief note describing a business opportunity you’ve personally created and closed through proactive outreach. If you’re energized by opening new markets, building trusted relationships, and helping customers solve real business problems with AI, you’ll thrive at Vikara. refive is building the engagement layer for physical retail: digital receipts, QR/NFC touchpoints, and post-purchase journeys that help brands and retailers turn anonymous shoppers into known customers. We work with retailers like Puma, EuroShop, and Orlen and are scaling fast across Europe and beyond. We are a close-knit team, distributed across three continents, with a base in Berlin. We're building an AI powered startup, flat heirarchy and a tight, efficient team.This is a Head of Marketing operating model inside a lean-team structure. You own the entire marketing function: strategy, content, SEO, events, partner co-marketing, and brand, and you run most of it through AI-powered workflows and agentic automation rather than headcount.The bar is high: you need to zoom from annual content strategy to line-level copy review to prompting a new automation pipeline - and know which mode each situation calls for. We move in sprints, ship fast, and never let perfect be the enemy of good.TasksContent quality and brand voice: Own the editorial standard across everything that goes out — LinkedIn posts, blog content, SEO copy, case studies, newsletter. You are the last human filter before anything is published. You can tell the difference between content that performs and content that just sounds like AI generated it, and you fix the latter.AI content engine: Direct and maintain agentic pipelines that produce content at scale. You set direction, write the prompts, evaluate the output, and intervene when the machine gets it wrong. This is already partially built; you evolve and own it.Account-based marketing support: Align the content calendar with live pipeline priorities. Brief assets for key accounts. Make sure sales has what it needs, when it needs it — not generic collateral.SEO and inbound: Own organic growth. Blog strategy, keyword targeting, distribution playbook, conversion path optimisation.Brand and thought leadership: Evolve the Retail Spotlight podcast into a content ecosystem. Ghostwrite and direct founder voice content across two distinct voices. Build refive's presence as the authoritative voice on in-store customer engagement in Europe.Events and field: Project-manage event participation remotely — NRF, EuroShop, RTS London and similar. Own the full loop: logistics, pre-event content, on-site coordination with vendors and booth teams, lead capture workflows, post-event follow-up content. You run this independently; founders show up and present.Partner co-marketing: Develop joint campaigns and launch materials with white-label and integration partners as the pipeline scales.Metrics and reporting: Own the automated weekly marketing dashboard (GA4, HubSpot, LinkedIn). Know your numbers. Flag what is not working before anyone asks.Requirements6-8 years of B2B SaaS or tech marketing experience, with real ownership - not just execution support.You have run campaigns end to end and have results to show.Fluent, flawless native spokend and written englishAgentic automation fluency. You have built or designed workflows using tools like Claude Code, n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar. You are comfortable prompting LLMs for structured outputs and wiring them into repeatable pipelines. This is not a nice-to-have it is how this role operates day to day.Strategic range with execution instinct. You can write a marketing plan in the morning and review a CTA in the afternoon. You know when to go deep and when to move on.Content quality instinct. You can tell the difference between AI-generated content that performs and content that just sounds like it was AI-generated. You write well yourself - sharp, no fluff, B2B-appropriate.Modern mindset, not stuck in old-school playbooks. Curious about what new tools can do, comfortable with ambiguity, willing to try things that have no case study yet - but experienced enough to know what good looks like and push back when a shortcut will cost you later.HubSpot and GA4 proficiency. You track what matters and use data to change direction, not validate decisions already made.Retail or martech experience is a genuine plus — if you understand how brick-and-mortar retailers think about footfall, loyalty, and first-party data, you will ramp faster and produce better work.One or more European language skills are a significant bonus given our primary market. But not a must have.BenefitsEnd-to-end ownership of a marketing function with real enterprise customers and a clear growth pathThe chance to build and document an AI-first lean marketing playbook - a genuinely novel problemAttractive compensation package and options after year 1Training budget and access to the latest AI toolingDirect access to the founding team and meaningful strategic input from day oneWork from home or Goa or the mountains, wherever you want as long as you have a perfect internet connectionWe use heavy agentic automation across content, research, and reporting. This role is not about doing more with less, it is about designing systems that handle the repeatable work so human judgment goes where it actually matters. If that excites you, you will fit here. If you prefer full manual control over every deliverable, this is probably not the right environment.To apply, send your CV plus responses to both tasks below. Please use the "Cover Letter" field for that. Applications without both tasks completed will not be reviewed.Task 1: Editorial eye. Here is a LinkedIn post a retail tech founder drafted but never published: "Excited to share that we've just launched our new in-store customer engagement solution that helps retailers leverage data-driven insights to optimize their omnichannel strategy and drive meaningful ROI across touchpoints. This is a game-changer for the industry. #retail #innovation #customerexperience." Rewrite it. Then tell us in two sentences what was wrong with the original.Task 2: Systems thinking. We publish a new blog post every two weeks. Sketch the automation workflow you would build to turn each post into a week of LinkedIn content across two founder accounts. Cover: triggers, tools, prompts, and, critically, what a human reviews and when. A rough diagram or a numbered list of steps both work. We are not looking for a perfect answer. We are looking at how you think. You know when to go deep and when to move on.Content quality instinct. You can tell the difference between AI-generated content that performs and content that just sounds like it was AI-generated. You write well yourself - sharp, no fluff, B2B-appropriate.Modern mindset, not stuck in old-school playbooks. Curious about what new tools can do, comfortable with ambiguity, willing to try things that have no case study yet - but experienced enough to know what good looks like and push back when a shortcut will cost you later.HubSpot and GA4 proficiency. You track what matters and use data to change direction, not validate decisions already made.Retail or martech experience is a genuine plus — if you understand how brick-and-mortar retailers think about footfall, loyalty, and first-party data, you will ramp faster and produce better work.One or more European language skills are a significant bonus given our primary market. But not a must have.BenefitsEnd-to-end ownership of a marketing function with real enterprise customers and a clear growth pathThe chance to build and document an AI-first lean marketing playbook - a genuinely novel problemAttractive compensation package and options after year 1Training budget and access to the latest AI toolingDirect access to the founding team and meaningful strategic input from day oneWork from home or Goa or the mountains, wherever you want as long as you have a perfect internet connectionWe use heavy agentic automation across content, research, and reporting. This role is not about doing more with less, it is about designing systems that handle the repeatable work so human judgment goes where it actually matters. If that excites you, you will fit here. If you prefer full manual control over every deliverable, this is probably not the right environment.To apply, send your CV plus responses to both tasks below. Please use the "Cover Letter" field for that. Applications without both tasks completed will not be reviewed.Task 1: Editorial eye. Here is a LinkedIn post a retail tech founder drafted but never published: "Excited to share that we've just launched our new in-store customer engagement solution that helps retailers leverage data-driven insights to optimize their omnichannel strategy and drive meaningful ROI across touchpoints. This is a game-changer for the industry. #retail #innovation #customerexperience." Rewrite it. Then tell us in two sentences what was wrong with the original.Task 2: Systems thinking. We publish a new blog post every two weeks. Sketch the automation workflow you would build to turn each post into a week of LinkedIn content across two founder accounts. Cover: triggers, tools, prompts, and, critically, what a human reviews and when. A rough diagram or a numbered list of steps both work. We are not looking for a perfect answer. We are looking at how you think.

About WPP MediaWPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.comAt WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity. Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust. Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise. Role Summary And ImpactAs part of our Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will partner with teams across the U.S., Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact, integrated media planning solutions across multiple markets and channels.We are looking for a Senior Director – Media Planning who will:Strategic Client Leadership & Planning: Act as the senior planning lead and strategic partner for global and multi‑market clients, ensuring media planning excellence aligned with client business objectives.Maintain a relentless focus on driving client outcome growth, applying performance‑led planning principles, data‑informed audience insights, optimisation thinking and advanced analytical perspectives to planning decision‑making.Serve as a subject‑matter expert across multiple channels and planning practices, with a strong understanding of how channels work together to deliver short‑ and long‑term client outcomes.Provide strategic guidance and recommendations on the optimal use of media products, services and solutions, ensuring alignment with client needs, business strategy and return on investment expectations.Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, nurturing long‑term relationships and supporting clients in navigating complex business challenges, organisational change and evolving market dynamics.Demonstrate deep understanding of client businesses, including successes, challenges and strategic priorities, and apply experience‑based judgement to identify opportunities, risks and trade‑offs from a business perspective.Lead senior‑level planning discussions across multiple stakeholders, effectively synthesising and reconciling diverse or conflicting inputs to drive alignment and shared understanding.Embed performance‑led and outcome‑oriented thinking into the planning process by ensuring that insights, intelligence and forecasts from activation and specialist teams are reflected in strategic recommendations.Define and oversee planning‑level KPIs, governance frameworks and planning processes that enable optimisation, benchmarking and continuous improvement across client portfolios.Champion a data‑driven planning culture, partnering with analytics and data science teams to prioritise initiatives and ensure insights are effectively translated into planning outputs.Develop high‑level growth and commercial planning perspectives for assigned clients or portfolios, including directional forecasts, profitability considerations and identification of priority growth areas.Maintain a strong understanding of WPP Media agency deliverables and committed campaign KPIs, ensuring planning outputs are aligned with agreed client expectations.Represent the planning discipline with credibility in senior client meetings, contributing technical and strategic expertise when required.Own the senior client engagement cadence from a planning perspective, including strategic sessions, status forums and cross‑functional meetings, ensuring consistent and high‑quality representation of the planning function.Take ownership of key planning workstreams on complex or multi‑market initiatives, ensuring clarity of scope, appropriate governance and high‑quality outputs.Capability Development: Identify capability gaps within media planning teams supporting client portfolios and define actions to address them through development, upskilling or targeted hiring. Partner with global planning practices, investment, product and solutions teams to help develop and drive adoption of new proprietary solutions on behalf of the OpCo.Represent the planning perspective in shaping capability priorities for the Polish GOC, ensuring alignment with broader WPP Media standards, expectations and strategic direction.Own the development and long‑term evolution of the Media Planning discipline within the Polish GOC, including definition of role profiles, competency frameworks and quality standards.Provide leadership and oversight for planning talent, establishing consistent development approaches, evaluation principles and coaching practices that support high performance and career progression.Build and maintain planning governance, including methodologies, templates and quality assurance standards, to ensure consistency, scalability and excellence of planning outputs.Foster a culture of continuous improvement and knowledge sharing within the planning community, supporting best‑practice exchange across teams and markets.Collaboration & Leadership: Operate effectively within a complex, matrixed organizational environment, providing leadership through influence and partnership across client, planning and activation teams.Collaborate closely with client leadership, activation leads and regional stakeholders to ensure alignment between strategic intent, planning outputs and execution delivery.Represent the planning discipline with credibility across cross‑functional forums, ensuring consistent understanding of objectives, priorities and expectations.Enable effective communication and knowledge sharing between planning and activation teams, fostering clarity, collaboration and continuous improvement.Outline, monitor and support adherence to agreed client and WPP Media standards, ensuring planning excellence is consistently reflected across engagements.Partner with senior stakeholders to identify gaps, risks or misalignments, and contribute to the development of action plans and improvement frameworks.Act as a senior counterpart to Activation Directors and Leads, promoting shared accountability for client outcomes and strong collaboration across disciplines.Lead by example in building a collaborative, inclusive and high‑performance culture, encouraging teamwork, ownership and professional growth across teams.Data-Driven Insights: Utilize advanced data analytics to understand media performance deeply, and guide optimization strategies ensuring maximum ROI. Provides expert insights on the application of data science and how to effectively use client and all biddable data signals. Future-Forward Thinking: Stay ahead of media and technology trends, providing guidance on emerging opportunities and threats. Proactively develops blueprints and action plans to help propel achieving client business objectives by bringing together practitioners across practices, proprietary solutions and extended WPP Media capabilities, at a regional level.Skills And Experience15+ years of experience in across paid media, strategy, retail, or consulting, including senior roles requiring leadership and accountability for teams and stakeholders.Expertise in digital media, adtech, martech and data platforms Proven track record of managing complex, multi-market accounts where you’ve delivered measurable business outcomes.Deep knowledge of multi-practice area/industry usage and trends, and how it impacts customer businesses.Ability to communicate in a way that is highly persuasive, engaging and comprehensive (written and verbal).Fluent in different types of media strategy – and understands that the road to strong brand is paved with performance marketing principles at the core.Sophisticated understanding of the media investment, ad tech and agency ecosystemExperience overseeing technology and/or operations transformation programs.Ability to tell complex narratives in a simple and compelling way.Passion for digital and data, well versed on the latest global advancements & dynamics.Ability to lead through influence, demonstrating strong interpersonal skills, empathy and credibility across seniority levels.Demonstrated experience owning and leading senior client planning relationships across large, complex, and matrixed client teams.Proven capability leadership: building a planning team, hiring for defined profiles, and developing a discipline at scale, including people development, performance management and succession planning.Life At WPP Media & BenefitsOur passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. About WPP MediaWPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.For more information, visit wppmedia.com.WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.comRoleAt WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity. Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust. Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise. Role Summary And ImpactAs part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Director - Ecommerce who will:Manage integration of media commerce campaigns with overall mainline & off-platform digitalcampaign planning & execution.Execute & Track performance of all media commerce campaigns for the client, across search,display, DSP and off-platform performance marketing campaigns.Lead Evangelization of the use of e-commerce across all client media plans & drive early adoption with both internal & external teams.Skills And ExperienceUnderstands the e-commerce ecosystem & business landscape (Marketplace, E-grocers, Hyperlocal platforms etc.)Strong understanding of the digital ad & media platforms like Google, FB, Amazon, etc. – knowledge on capability, metrics & business implication on client’s e-commerce business strategyAbility to leverage industry connects & sources to help achieve the e-commerce targets for the client.Has execution experience & understanding of e-commerce industry ad platforms like Amazon Search, DSP, etc. and strong knowledge of media opportunities that exist on other e-commerce platforms Experience of having managed performance marketing & brand media campaigns on leading ecommerce platforms will be a plusExperience of working in roles such as Category Management/Marketing, Media Monetization, Ecommerce Key Account Management, Business Development & Strategic AlliancesLife At WPP Media & BenefitsOur passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. Role OverviewWe are hiring a Managing Director to lead the strategy, delivery, and enterprise‑scale adoption of agent‑based automation across global financial services operations. This role sits within the Global Delivery Simplification organization and is accountable for transforming how complex, control‑intensive operational processes are executed using agentic AI in a highly regulated environment.The Managing Director will own the end‑to‑end product portfolio for agent‑driven solutions across Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Transfer Agency, and Custody, with full accountability for value realization, risk posture, and sustained operational performance at scale.This role combines senior product leadership, people management, and executive‑level stakeholder accountability, requiring strong judgment, organizational influence, and ownership of outcomes well beyond initial delivery.ROLE PURPOSEThe Managing Director leads multiple cross‑functional PODs responsible for conceiving, delivering, scaling, and governing agentic AI solutions across core business services including Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Transfer Agency, and Custody.The role is accountable for enterprise‑level product strategy, investment prioritization, roadmap governance, and value realization of agent‑based automation, ensuring solutions deliver material operational impact while meeting regulatory, audit, data governance, and model risk management expectations.Success in this role requires the ability to set clear strategic direction, balance innovation with operational resilience, and institutionalize controls, auditability, and explainability as non‑negotiable product standards.Key Responsibilities Own enterprise‑level business outcomes for agent‑based automation, including efficiency, capacity, quality, client experience, and risk reduction. Define and communicate the long‑term vision and strategy for agentic AI across global operations. Set strategic priorities across Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Transfer Agency, and Custody based on materiality, risk, and value. Sponsor identification and sequencing of high‑impact automation opportunities across the operating model. Ensure alignment of product strategy with regulatory expectations, enterprise AI risk frameworks, and control standards. Govern translation of simplification objectives into coherent product portfolios, roadmaps, and investment cases. Provide executive oversight of agile delivery, ensuring consistency of standards, outcomes, and operational readiness across PODs. Own the full lifecycle governance of agentic AI solutions, including approval frameworks, human‑in‑the‑loop models, escalation design, and decommissioning decisions. Establish enterprise standards for controls, auditability, explainability, and evidence capture in agent‑based solutions. Set materiality thresholds, risk tolerances, and escalation models for autonomous and semi‑autonomous execution. Make portfolio‑level decisions to scale, pause, remediate, or retire agents based on performance, risk, and value realization. Oversee production performance management including accuracy trends, systemic failure patterns, and control effectiveness. Lead and develop senior Product Owners and product leaders, setting clear expectations and accountability for outcomes. Partner with senior operations, risk, compliance, audit, data, and technology leaders to ensure enterprise alignment. Define, track, and report value realization, risk metrics, and control outcomes to executive governance forums. Represent Global Delivery Simplification in senior leadership discussions related to AI strategy, operational resilience, and regulatory engagement.Skills And Capabilities Advanced product leadership capability, including portfolio strategy, investment governance, and organizational alignment. Exceptional judgment in balancing automation ambition, operational risk, regulatory scrutiny, and reputational considerations. Proven experience leading and developing senior product and delivery leaders. Executive‑level communication and influencing skills across business, technology, and control functions. Deep expertise in one or more operational domains (Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Transfer Agency, or Custody) with enterprise perspective. Strong understanding of agentic AI risk, evaluation, monitoring, and control design at scale. Ability to interpret enterprise‑level telemetry, systemic risk signals, and performance trends. Deep understanding of data governance, model risk management, and audit expectations in regulated environments.Experience Requirements 12+ years of experience leading products, platforms, or transformations in complex, regulated operational environments. Senior leadership experience in global financial services operations. Demonstrated ownership of enterprise‑scale automation or AI portfolios. Extensive experience working with risk, compliance, audit, and regulators. Proven track record of scaling solutions into sustained business‑as‑usual operations. Experience operating in product‑centric, agile organizations at scale.About State StreetAcross the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We invite applications for Deputy Manager - Delivery & Web Content to serve as the Champion for Ford of Europe ‘Build and Price’ platform, leading the engagement between our European Markets and the Central FoE team. The role sits at the center of market stakeholders, tech teams, product architects, and product managers—navigating market-specific nuances to ensure precise delivery of requirements across our Passenger and Commercial Vehicle portfolios.This position owns market engagement end-to-end, driving requirement clarity, stakeholder alignment, governance cadence, and market signoffs. It also leads to market and business-owner escalations, ensuring communication stays transparent, actions are time-bound, and closures are delivered with confidence. Ensuring Europe’s rigorous emission standards and diverse market regulations are accurately represented on websites is a core expectation of the role, enabled through the GPRS application and Enterprise Architect. A high standard of operational excellence is required to keep workstreams stable, minimize incidents, and sustain strong business satisfaction.As the primary lead, you bring together FBS Market Leads, Central EU teams, and regional business stakeholders, including joint venture partners—to maximize platform uptime across 17 markets. This includes ensuring continuous service availability and pricing precision for a portfolio of 300+ models. Rigorous governance is maintained across the end-to-end information pipeline, so every customer interaction remains seamless and fully compliant with EU emissions and legal mandates. Strong visual and data integrity is critical to safeguarding Ford’s digital reputation and optimizing the journey for every visitor.Core ResponsibilitiesBeyond strategic oversight, the role leads a high-performing execution team operating across complex data ecosystems such as PAM, GPRS, and BSL. Delivery orchestration with key agency partners (WPP VML, Oliver) is essential, along with rapid incident resolution and close synchronization with IT, Product, and JV stakeholders to ensure flawless go-to-market execution for new program launches.Job Responsibilities:Lead cross-functional teams through structured triage and incident remediation during critical live-site issues; implement lasting fixes to prevent recurrence and protect platform uptime.Spearhead execution of strategic roadmaps and new design program integrations across the Ford EU Digital platform, partnering with IT, Agency, and Business leadership to deliver committed milestones.Own market and business-owner governance to align priorities, manage dependencies, and close delivery blockers across markets, central teams, and agencies.Re-engineer pricing and market campaign workflows (including pricelist implementation) to reduce turnaround time and improve delivery reliability.Establish and run central governance for WLTP attribute mapping in GPRS and PRG wireframes, ensuring accurate display of emissions and technical data across the digital ecosystem.Ensure Model Year changeover readiness by maintaining complete availability of Emission, Dimension, and Weight & Load data across all Nameplates and unique vehicle programs.Align cycle refreshes for JV vehicle programs by proactively managing product specification readiness, timing, and stakeholder dependencies.Oversee vehicles launch digital assets end-to-end (delivery and controls), coordinating with Oliver and conducting configuration-matrix audits in JIRA to ensure correct content/images in customer experience.Build and sustain a high-performing team through talent acquisition and onboarding that prioritizes excellence, cultural alignment, and technical readiness.Additional Responsibilities Lead technology and process modernization across reporting, analytics, and data workflows by adopting industry practices and automating manual activities; partner with Automation and Re-engineering teams to deploy scalable solutions. Establish an operating cadence for leadership through daily/weekly briefings, performance scorecards, and forward-looking forecasts—enabling decisions on capacity utilization, delivery health, and new business scalability, with transparent reporting and timely approvals. Mentor leads by coaching them on delivery governance, stakeholder management, and incident handling, while actively supporting market-to-FBS escalation management. Foster a motivated, inclusive day-to-day working culture that strengthens collaboration and accountability, reinforces high performance, and improves team engagement through. Ensure adherence to MCRP, SoX, and GAO requirements to sustain ‘Nil Comments’ audit status through updated checklists, complete audit trails, and execution of Business Continuity Plan (BCP) practice drills. Partner with the department head on day-to-day operations and leadership cadence, covering performance reviews, strategic upskilling, governance, talent development, and workflow optimization.The Minimum Requirements We Seek Master’s degree (e.g., MBA, PGDM, MSBA) or an equivalent advanced degree. 8-10 Yrs of exclusive experience in business operations management 3+ years of experience with leading and coaching team leaders (directly orindirectly) by demonstrating standard methodologies in market engagement, program management & communication Candidate should have managed small-to-medium-sized teamsOur Preferred Requirements Demonstrated leadership in managing significant projects and programs, overseeing cross-functional teams to ensure successful, timely, and delivery of business solutions. Ability to develop and execute roadmaps, manage market relationships, build partnerships, and proactively mitigate risks to enhance operational excellence and system integrity. Exceptional communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders at all levels and foster team alignment. Strong analytical and data-driven problem-solving skills, utilizing business intelligence (BI) tools for strategic insights. Deep understanding and practical application of various business operation and process management methodologies (e.g., Business Process Management/Reengineering, Theory of Constraints). PMP, Agile (CSM, SAFe), or other relevant delivery management certifications are highly desirable.
