normalizedText: Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further. Job Title Vice President – Retail Marketing strategy, Brand Partnership & Events Business / Function International Wealth & Personal Banking / Global Banking & Markets Location [Mumbai India] Grade GCB 5 Job Introduction The Global Marketing function is focused on supporting the strategic and revenue growth priorities of the Bank. The function focuses on understanding customers and the identification, development and execution of Marketing strategies, campaigns and activities that support and strengthen the HSBC brand, support the drive for revenue and increase customer value and satisfaction in order to meet agreed targets and objectives at both a global and market level.This role will be responsible to bring new Brand partners, create long term Intellectual properties(IPs), strategy and framework for delivery of all events, third party sponsorships and the coordination of all activities to drive Brand recall, acquire new customers and engage with existing customers for HSBC Wealth & Personal Banking business in India.Principal Responsibilities Lead the development and execution of HSBC India’s brand partnership strategy to strengthen brand equity, deepen customer engagement and drive commercial outcomes across priority businesses. Identify, evaluate and negotiate strategic partnerships across sports, entertainment, fashion, travel, luxury, culture, technology and lifestyle that enhance HSBC’s brand proposition and create differentiated customer value. Build and manage a portfolio of signature HSBC-owned intellectual properties (IPs) and flagship experiences that reinforce the bank’s positioning and support customer acquisition, engagement and retention. Develop integrated content strategies that amplify campaigns across paid, owned and earned channels, ensuring consistency of brand messaging and measurable business impact. Lead the conceptualisation and delivery of premium client experiences, large-scale events and sponsorship activations, ensuring world-class execution and alignment with HSBC’s global brand standards. Work closely with business teams including Wealth & Premier Banking, Credit Cards, Commercial Banking and Corporate Communications to translate business priorities into impactful marketing programmes. Collaborate with global, regional and local stakeholders to identify opportunities to localise global partnerships and maximise their relevance for the Indian market. Establish strategic relationships with leading rights holders, agencies, creators, media partners and event organisers to unlock innovative collaboration opportunities. Drive end-to-end management of sponsorships and partnerships, including commercial negotiations, governance, activation planning, legal and compliance coordination, measurement and reporting. Lead content creation across multiple formats including digital, social, experiential, video and thought leadership, ensuring relevance to target customer segments and HSBC’s brand positioning. Develop measurement frameworks and KPIs to evaluate partnership effectiveness, event ROI, customer engagement, brand health and commercial impact, using insights to optimise future investments. Manage annual budgets, procurement processes and agency partnerships to ensure efficient allocation of resources and delivery against agreed objectives. Ensure all marketing activities comply with HSBC’s governance, regulatory, legal, risk and brand requirements. Stay abreast of emerging consumer trends, cultural movements, technology innovations and partnership opportunities to continuously evolve HSBC India’s marketing capabilities. Mentor and develop team members while fostering a culture of creativity, collaboration, accountability and execution excellence. Key Success Measures Brand consideration and perception improvement. Growth in customer acquisition and engagement through partnerships. Commercial impact generated from sponsorships and partner programmes. ROI and effectiveness of events and experiential marketing. Reach and engagement of integrated content campaigns. Successful delivery of flagship HSBC IPs and customer experiences. Stakeholder satisfaction across business, regional and global teams. Strong governance, risk management and budget optimisation. Role Requirements / Qualification / Experience Strategic thinker with the ability to translate business priorities into differentiated brand, partnership and experiential marketing strategies. Proven capability to originate, negotiate and manage high-value strategic partnerships with leading brands, rights holders, agencies and commercial partners. Strong commercial acumen with experience demonstrating measurable business outcomes, customer acquisition, engagement and return on marketing investment. Deep understanding of affluent and wealth customer segments, premium consumer behaviour and luxury marketing. Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior business leaders across local, regional and global teams. Demonstrated leadership in delivering integrated marketing programmes across digital, content, events, sponsorships and customer experiences. Strong negotiation, influencing and contract management capabilities. Experience managing multiple agencies, production partners and cross-functional teams in a highly matrixed organisation. Ability to balance creativity with governance, regulatory requirements, risk management and brand compliance. Strong analytical mindset with experience using customer insights and campaign performance metrics to drive optimisation. Exceptional communication, presentation and executive storytelling skills. Ability to lead through ambiguity while managing multiple high-profile initiatives simultaneously. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications or a related discipline. MBA or Postgraduate qualification from a reputed institution preferred. Professional certifications in Marketing, Brand Strategy, Digital Marketing or Sponsorship Management would be advantageous. Strong understanding of financial services marketing and regulatory requirements is desirable. Experience 12–15+ years of progressive experience in strategic marketing, brand management, partnerships, sponsorships, content or experiential marketing. Demonstrated success in leading large-scale integrated marketing campaigns with measurable commercial impact. Proven track record of developing and commercialising strategic partnerships across sectors such as sports, entertainment, travel, luxury, fashion, technology or lifestyle. Experience leading premium customer experiences, flagship events and sponsorship activations from strategy through execution. Experience managing significant marketing budgets and driving optimisation based on ROI and performance metrics. Strong experience working with senior executives, external partners and global stakeholders. Prior experience within banking, financial services, premium consumer brands or multinational organisations is highly preferred. Experience leading and developing high-performing marketing teams in a matrix environment. Demonstrated ability to build and scale proprietary brand IPs that enhance customer engagement and brand differentiation. Pro-tip : Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.Additional Information Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. progressive leadership experience in enterprise software / SaaS.Demonstrated ownership of a multi-million-dollar P&L, with a track record of building and scaling a business or business unit and being and with partners, not just direct.Exceptional execution and cross-functional leadership — proven ability to mobilize and align teams across Sales, Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and About The RoleWe’re looking for a Director of Strategy & Operations - a startup operator who can bring clarity and execution discipline to fast-growing teams, drive cross-functional alignment, and scale systems that actually work. You’ll sit at the intersection of strategy, ops, and product, leading key initiatives that move the business forward - from improving sales-to-onboarding flows to optimizing our care and claims operations. This is a builder’s role. You’ll be hands-on in diagnosing bottlenecks, designing scalable processes, and driving measurable impact on growth, efficiency, and profitability.What You Will Do Build and Scale Core Systems Redesign workflows across Sales, Ops, and Care to remove friction and increase throughput. Drive automation and tool adoption across teams to improve accuracy and turnaround times. Create repeatable playbooks for key business processes as we scale from thousands to millions of covered lives. Lead Cross-Functional Initiatives Run company-wide programs that cut across business lines — from new product launches to cost optimization and customer experience initiatives. Be the go-to person for execution clarity — aligning teams, setting clear metrics, and ensuring momentum. Partner closely with Product and Tech to translate business needs into scalable tools. Operational Excellence Define and track key performance metrics (TATs, retention, margin, NPS, etc.) across verticals. Build the operating cadence — reviews, dashboards, reporting rhythms — to keep teams accountable. Identify and eliminate waste in processes using Lean / continuous improvement methods. Strategic Projects Lead short-term, high-impact projects directly sponsored by the CEO or COO. Analyse performance drivers, run experiments, and recommend where to double down. Support fundraising, board discussions, and strategic planning through data-backed insights.What We Are Looking For 10+ years of experience in strategy, ops, product, or business leadership roles at high-growth startups (fintech, health tech, or ops-heavy businesses preferred). Have scaled or rebuilt a core business function before — whether it’s supply ops, CX, or go-to-market. Think in systems, not silos — you enjoy connecting dots across functions and making things flow. Are analytical and execution-focused — equally comfortable in spreadsheets and on the floor with teams. Have an engineering background and you love to solve hard problems.Why Loop Mission that matters: Redefine how healthcare works for millions of Indians. Autonomy & Impact: Direct access to leadership and ownership of high-stakes initiatives. Startup pace, grown-up problems: Work on challenges that combine scale, complexity, and purpose. Culture of builders: Smart, humble teammates who care deeply about doing great work. normalizedText: Join Us!At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!As a Developer Team Lead, you will serve as a strategic leader and resource for the email production team and central point of contact for the onshore team for all questions production. You will provide guidance and support throughout the email marketing production lifecycle; from intake to deployment. Your main priority is to lead your team to produce email marketing campaigns with quality on time and without errors. You will also be the driving force for continuous quality improvement.Position ResponsibilitiesManage E2E email campaign production processLead production team (consisting of HTML developers and QA / teamsRepresent needs of the production teams to the onshore teamManaging localization processSubmitting, receiving and actioning campaign localization requests Ensuring timely turnaround of reporting such as total and project level capacity utilization, post-production error measurement, change request monitoring, etc.Drive efficiency and process innovationProactively identify processesManage implementation of changes with the teamQualificationsMinimum Qualifications:7+ years of experience in marketing automation and operations and 3+ years of experience working with Job Description: Director- MarketingLocation: BangaloreType: Full-TimeExperience: 12-16 yrsIndustry: SAAS and B2BAbout AsperAt Asper, we're transforming enterprise growth through AI. Our AI-powered Growth Platform enables businesses to make smarter, faster commercial decisions across pricing, promotions, assortment, and demand. As AI reshapes how enterprises operate, our ambition is to establish Asper as the most trusted and preferred AI platform for growth.We're looking for a visionary Marketing Director to lead this journey.The OpportunityWe are seeking a strategic, market-facing Marketing Director to shape Asper's category leadership and accelerate our brand as the AI platform of choice for enterprise growth.This is not a traditional product marketing role. You will define how the market perceives Asper, influence industry conversations around Enterprise AI, and create compelling narratives that resonate with customers, analysts, partners, investors, and employees.Working closely with the CEO, Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Leadership teams, you will own the strategy that positions Asper at the forefront of the AI revolution.Key ResponsibilitiesShape Asper's Market LeadershipDefine and execute the marketing strategy that positions Asper as the leading AI-powered Growth Platform.Develop differentiated positioning and messaging that clearly articulates Asper's value to enterprise customers.Drive category creation initiatives and build long-term brand preference in the AI and enterprise software landscape.Lead Product Marketing & Go-to-MarketOwn end-to-end go-to-market strategy for new products, AI capabilities, and platform innovations.Partner with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Demand Generation teams to deliver successful launches.Develop customer-centric messaging, value propositions, and positioning that drive adoption and revenue growth.Build Asper's AI NarrativeTranslate complex AI technologies into compelling business stories that resonate with enterprise leaders.Shape Asper's voice around Generative AI, Agentic AI, Predictive AI, and enterprise decision intelligence.Continuously monitor AI trends, competitive movements, and customer needs to keep Asper ahead of the market.Establish Thought LeadershipPartner with the CEO and leadership team to build Asper's presence through industry events, analyst briefings, media, webinars, blogs, and executive content.Build relationships with analysts, influencers, partners, and the broader AI ecosystem.Position Asper as a trusted authority in AI-driven growth and commercial decision intelligence.Strengthen Brand PerceptionLead strategic brand initiatives that enhance awareness, credibility, and preference among enterprise buyers.Create impactful customer stories, case studies, whitepapers, and content that reinforce Asper's market leadership.Drive integrated campaigns that increase brand visibility and support demand generation objectives.Enable Commercial SuccessDevelop compelling sales enablement assets, executive presentations, industry messaging, and competitive battle cards.Equip customer-facing teams with the tools and narratives needed to articulate Asper's unique differentiation.Support strategic enterprise opportunities through executive-level messaging and marketing support.Influence Business StrategyBring customer insights, market intelligence, and competitive analysis into product and business planning.Work closely with Product Leadership to influence roadmap priorities based on evolving market opportunities.Identify emerging trends that unlock new growth opportunities for Asper.Requirements12–16 years of experience in Product Marketing, Strategic Marketing, or B2B Enterprise Marketing.Proven experience in enterprise SaaS, AI, analytics, cloud platforms, or data-driven technology companies.Strong track record of developing product positioning, leading go-to-market strategies, and building market awareness.Experience working in high-growth technology companies or startups is highly desirable.EducationMBA or master's degree in management is highly preferred from tier one institute.Why Join Asper?Shape the brand and market perception of a fast-growing AI company.Work at the forefront of Enterprise AI innovation.Collaborate closely with founders and executive leadership.Play a defining role in establishing Asper as the most preferred AI Growth Platform for global enterprises.Be part of a high-impact team solving real-world business challenges through AI.ExpertiseDeep understanding of the AI ecosystem, including Generative AI, Agentic AI, LLMs, enterprise AI applications, and emerging technologies.Strong strategic thinking with experience in category creation and brand positioning.Excellent storytelling and communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technology for business audiences.Experience engaging with industry analysts (Gartner, Forrester, IDC), partners, and executive stakeholders is a plus.Leadership QualitiesWe're looking for someone who:Thinks strategically and acts with an ownership mindset.Is passionate about AI, innovation, and emerging technologies.Combines creativity with strong commercial acumen.Influences across functions and builds strong stakeholder relationships.Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.Is excited about building a category-defining AI company. Key ResponsibilitiesExecutive Advisory & Enterprise Transformation LeadershipServe as a strategic advisor to C-suite executives across enterprise customer engagements. Lead the most complex and high-impact transformation programs involving customer experience, personalization, AI-enabled operations, content supply chain transformation, and digital operating model modernization. Define long-term transformation strategies aligned to measurable business outcomes, organizational change, and customer value realization. Drive executive workshops, value realization discussions, digital maturity initiatives, and transformation governance. Influence enterprise investment priorities and strategic adoption roadmaps. Business Growth & Practice ExpansionDrive consulting-led growth opportunities, multi-million-dollar expansion initiatives, and strategic account development. Identify new consulting offerings, innovation opportunities, AI-native services, and reusable frameworks to scale the SBC practice. Partner closely with sales, regional leadership, delivery teams, product organizations, and executives to shape strategic pursuits and business growth. Contribute directly to renewals, executive relationship management, and long-term customer partnerships. Strengthen SBC organizational positioning through strategic customer success stories and innovation leadership. AI Leadership & Innovation StrategyChampion AI adoption across consulting methodologies, customer transformation programs, and operational models. Define AI-native consulting approaches focused on personalization, automation, content intelligence, predictive insights, and productivity transformation. Drive innovation strategies that improve consulting scalability, delivery efficiency, customer value realization, and business growth. Act as a thought leader on emerging trends across AI, customer experience strategy, digital transformation, and enterprise operations. People Leadership, Mentoring & Organizational ImpactLead, mentor, and inspire consulting teams across strategic engagements and regional programs. Build high-performing consulting culture through coaching, mentorship, capability development, and leadership enablement. Support hiring, succession planning, competency development, organizational mentoring, and consulting enablement programs. Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and strategic thinking across the organization. Represent Adobe and the SBC organization at customer events, industry forums, executive workshops, and leadership discussions. Preferred QualificationsBachelor’s degree required; MBA strongly preferred. Minimum 15 years of experience in strategic consulting, digital transformation, customer experience, or enterprise technology strategy. Extensive expertise across Adobe Experience Cloud and enterprise digital ecosystems. Strong executive presence with demonstrated experience influencing C-level stakeholders and driving strategic business outcomes. Proven track record in consulting growth, innovation leadership, mentoring, and organizational impact. normalizedText: CardioMetabolic MarketingNovo Nordisk Pvt Ltd (Affiliate)Your new roleThe Associate Director – Marketing, Obesity & Key Accounts will be responsible for leading the end-to-end brand strategy and execution for Wegovy in India. The role is accountable for driving business growth, strengthening brand positioning, and shaping the obesity care market through insight-led and customer-centric strategies. It requires strong cross-functional leadership, strategic thinking, and the ability to translate plans into impactful and compliant execution. The role also requires agility to understand and adapt to evolving organisational structures, go-to-market models, and customer needs as the obesity market develops in India.Your key responsibilities as Associate Director – Marketing, Obesity & Key Accounts will include:Own and drive Wegovy brand strategy with accountability for business performance, including sales, market share, and profitabilityLead market shaping initiatives to improve obesity awareness, diagnosis, and treatment adoption in partnership with Medical, Market Access, and external stakeholdersDesign and execute an effective omnichannel customer engagement strategy for HCPs, institutions, and priority customer segmentsEnsure execution excellence through timely, high-quality implementation of marketing plans aligned to field needs and execution prioritiesDrive cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Medical, Market Access, and Global teams to ensure integrated planning and delivery of business objectivesManage lifecycle planning to support launch readiness, portfolio expansion, and long-term brand sustainabilityDevelop and execute key account/institution engagement plans, ensuring measurable outcomes and continuous adaptation to evolving market and organizational needsAbout International OperationsAs part of International Operations, you will join our largest operational unit. Covering 194 countries and 95% of the world's population, more than 18,000 of us work passionately to serve 35 million patients each day. With a promise to outperform the competition, we continue to be the growth driver for Novo Nordisk, and to improve health at scale across the globe.About The DepartmentThe Cardio-Metabolic Marketing team is responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies for cardiometabolic and related therapeutic areas. The team ensures strong brand leadership and measurable business performance by driving initiatives that improve disease awareness, appropriate diagnosis, and treatment adoption in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.Your Skills & QualificationsMBA / PGDM or equivalent qualification, preferably with a strong academic background.Approximately 12 years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical or healthcare marketing7–8 years of experience in the marketing domain and at least 4+ years of people management experiencePrior experience in launch strategy and execution, along with consumer awareness or patient activation campaigns, will be an added advantage.Demonstrated experience in leading brands, launch readiness, lifecycle management, or specialty portfoliosStrong track record in stakeholder management and cross-functional collaborationPrior exposure to high-growth, competitive, or innovative therapy areas will be an advantageWorking at Novo NordiskEvery day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.What We OfferThere is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.Deadline31 July 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants. We’re not your typical healthcare company. In a modern world of quick fixes, we focus on solutions to defeat serious chronic diseases and promote long-term health. Our unordinary mindset is at the heart of everything we do. We seek out new ideas and put people first as we push the boundaries of science, make healthcare more accessible, and treat, prevent, and even cure diseases that affect millions of lives. Because it takes an unordinary approach to drive real, lasting change in health. role: Senior Principal - Development & CMO Digital & Tech Strategy
normalizedText: GSK Development and Chief Medical Officer (CMO) Digital and Technology’s mission is to disrupt and transform the way GSK thinks about, generates and submits evidence to radically accelerate the delivery of medicines and vaccines for our patients and participants.We act as a strategic thought partner for the Development Operations and CMO organisations, bringing together diverse stakeholders to radically transform and connect siloed processes using innovative and integrated technology. Your roleAs the Senior Principal, Strategy you will be a pivotal partner for the Development and CMO Digital and Technology leadership team, responsible for both shaping our strategic agenda and driving its execution to help us radically accelerate the delivery of medicines and vaccines.You will probe and clarify strategic choices, lead analysis on critical business problems, and own high-priority initiatives from concept to completion. Alongside this, you will serve as a chief of staff to the leadership team - acting as the throughline across our planning cycles, governance, and leadership sessions to ensure strategy translates into decisive action. You will work closely with the R&D Digital and Technology Portfolio team, ensuring their capabilities and processes are leveraged in service of our objectives.This role requires you to move seamlessly between high-level strategic thinking and the hands-on work of keeping a complex leadership team focused, aligned, and moving forward.Your ResponsibilitiesDrive and Facilitate the Leadership Team's Strategic Agenda: Act as the throughline for the leadership team's strategic agenda - ensuring what gets discussed becomes decided, and what gets decided gets done. You will own the meeting rhythm: setting agendas, ensuring pre-reads are in place, and working with teams across the department to drive actions to completion between sessions.Lead High-Priority & Cross-Cutting Strategic Initiatives: Take direct ownership of ambiguous, high-impact projects, particularly those that cut across multiple programmes and teams. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle: shaping the hypothesis, conducting analysis, building consensus, and delivering integrated solutions that drive our transformation forward.Co-lead Annual Planning: In partnership with the Strategy Director, co-lead the annual planning cycle - driving both the OKR-setting process and the investment planning process, ensuring the two are aligned and that clear trade-off decisions are made.Build and Communicate a Shared Strategic Narrative: Own the communications that bring our strategy to life across the department - translating leadership decisions and strategic priorities into clear, compelling messages for all staff, so that everyone understands where we are going and how their work connects to it.Partner with the R&D Digital and Technology Portfolio Team: Work closely with the Portfolio team to ensure the operational processes that underpin both our strategic programmes and the day-to-day running of the department are effective and efficient — identifying where things aren't working and driving improvements that help the department deliver against its objectives.Why you?Basic Qualifications:Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a scientific area (e.g. computer science, engineering, mathematics), or related quantitative discipline.15+ Experience in technology strategy, within a large-scale technology organisation, a corporate strategy function, or a management consulting firm.Experience supporting or operating as chief of staff to a senior leadership team, including owning meeting rhythms, governance forums, and cross-team action tracking.Relevant experience in the life sciences industry.We are looking for professionals with the following capabilities:Senior Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to act as a trusted partner to leaders, building strong relationships, providing candid advice, and facilitating high-stakes discussions to drive alignment and clear decisions.Structured Problem-Solving and Analysis: A highly analytical mindset with the ability to take ambiguous, complex business problems, structure them, and drive them to a concrete solution through hands-on analysis and project management.Exceptional Communication and Synthesis: The ability to synthesise complex information into clear, concise narratives for a range of audiences, from executive leadership to all staff. You can distil the "so what" and make strategy feel relevant and actionable at every level.Preferred Qualifications:R&D Domain Knowledge: Understanding of the pharmaceutical R&D value chain, from drug discovery and clinical development through to regulatory submission.Agile Ways of Working: Familiarity with Agile principles and ways of working (e.g. Scrum, SAFe), with the ability to operate effectively within an organisation that runs on agile rhythms.AI-Augmented Working: Practical experience applying AI tools to accelerate strategic and analytical work, and a track record of helping others do the same — for example, driving adoption of AI tools that enhance how product owners and delivery teams operate day-to-day.SkillsChange Management, Compliance Risk Management, Dependency Analysis, Executive Reports, Financial Acumen, Portfolio Performance Management, Portfolio Prioritization, Problem Solving, Project Management Governance, Shareholder Communications, Stakeholder ManagementWhy GSK?Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.Inclusion at GSK:As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.Important notice to Employment businesses/ AgenciesGSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. normalizedText: Minimum qualifications:Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.8 years of experience in a technical project management or a customer-facing role. Preferred qualifications:Master’s degree in Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering or Applied Science, or a related field.10 years of experience leading scaled operations/Managed Service Providers (MSPs).Experience in process optimization methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, Value Stream Mapping) to identify bottlenecks and reduce customer effort.Ability to drive AI quality assurance and operational automation through prompt engineering, code-based workflow integrations (e.g., using Python, Java, Apps Script, or similar), and the development of Large Language Model (LLM)-powered agents and SQL-backed reporting dashboards.Familiarity with digital advertising technology, Google's sellside products (Google Ad Manager, AdMob, AdSense), or technical support environments.About the jobYou will be responsible for defining the future of quality assurance for our sellside support organization balancing the strategic design of our quality framework and the integration of AI tools and agentic technology with the operational execution and vendor management required to maintain high quality standards. You will serve as the independent "connective tissue" across cross-functional teams to resolve customer experience blockers and ensure consistent, high-value support delivery. You will lead the transition from manual, sample-based auditing to a 100% continuous coverage model powered by Gemini, setting a standard for quality operations at Google. You will work directly with gTech Ads Sellside technical support and consulting team, vendor management, Product, Global Partners (GP) Sellside, and regional technical support teams, including training functions to drive product improvements and process redesigns, holding the organization accountable for quality. You are an "AI-first" applicant who is willing to develop agents or use AI to automate heavy operational tasks and act as a team multiplier for the team's impact. You will interact face-to-face with Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and our internal vendor management team. You will be responsible for gathering direct feedback, aligning cross-functionally, driving down inaccuracies, and holding vendor operations accountable from an impartial standpoint.Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.To learn more about gTech, check out our video .ResponsibilitiesLead the design, evolution, and oversight of the Sellside Quality Framework, aligning audit criteria with the end-to-end publisher journey.Transform traditional manual auditing workflows to AI-powered, continuous baseline audits augmented by targeted human calibration and partner with technical teams to design, test, and implement agentic quality tools to scale audit coverage to 100%.Maximize AI reliability and accuracy by designing, testing, and relentlessly optimizing complex system prompts that successfully minimize hallucinations and efficiently handle challenging operational edge cases.Drive improvement of partner experiences, identifying areas of opportunity to streamline processes, content and strategy, implement updates etc.Manage daily operational activities (reporting, root cause analysis, and feedback loops) required to enforce quality standards and accountability across global vendor operations and Managed Service Providers (MSPs).Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form . OverviewPart of The Weber Shandwick Collective, we’re the earned-first global communications agency, led by world-class strategic thinkers and creative activators. We create shared and sustainable value for businesses, people, and society. We energize the right mix of talent, using the right platforms and latest technology to choreograph stories that make a real and meaningful impact for some of the world’s leading brands and businessesOur game-changing work is recognized by some of the most prestigious industry awards bodies, and we have won more than 135 Lions at the Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity. We’re also PRWeek’s 2024 Global Agency of the Year as well as being listed on the Ad Age A-List 2024 and Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies 2024.More than ever, organizations need to solve for unprecedented challenges born of technology-driven disruption. We fuse global teams grounded in technology, digital innovation and analytics to help clients. As we live in an always-on world, our brand positioning reflects this need to engage with our always-on audience, just as we advise our clients to do. We inspire. We incite. We shape ideas and conversations, and we activate our global reach for local causes and multinational brands alike, and we’re always ready for more problems to solve.Our Values:CURIOSITY – We cultivate curiosity and challenge convention. Because solving any problem begins by asking the right questionsINCLUSION – We foster teams and environments built on belonging and openness to possibility. Because the best ideas have no biasCOURAGE – We stand up for what we believe in. Because being comfortable with the uncomfortable is how progress is madeIMPACT – We strive to make a meaningful difference in everything we do. Because we owe it to our people, or clients and the worldAbout the opportunityDigital is no longer a specialist capability. It’s central to how brands build reputation, engage communities and create business impact.We’re looking for a leader who can shape the future of Weber Shandwick’s digital offering in Mumbai by bringing together strategy, creativity, technology and communications into truly integrated client solutions.You’ll lead our digital business in the market, partner with multidisciplinary teams, and help clients navigate an increasingly connected communications landscape. Just as importantly, you’ll play a key role in growing our digital capabilities, developing talent, and identifying new opportunities for our clients and our business.This role offers significant autonomy. You’ll have the support of senior leadership, but we’re looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership, is comfortable making decisions, and can maintain momentum in a fast-moving environment with the judgement to know when to seek support and when to lead from the front.If you’re excited by building capabilities, solving business problems through integrated communications, and helping shape what’s next, we’d like to hear from you.What You’ll Be Responsible ForLead Digital CommunicationsLead Weber Shandwick’s digital practice in Mumbai – standalone and integrated, ensuring strategic approach and business success as key outcomes.Develop integrated digital strategies that combine earned, owned, paid, influencer and content into cohesive communications programs.Partner closely with Consumer, Corporate, Public Affairs, Strategy and Creative teams to deliver integrated solutions that solve business challenges.Provide senior strategic counsel on digital communications to clients across sectors.Build Client & Business GrowthIdentify opportunities to expand digital capabilities across existing client relationships.Support and lead digital-led new business opportunities and integrated pitches.Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and become a strategic advisor on digital communications.Evolve the CapabilityContinuously evolve our digital capabilities by identifying and embedding emerging platforms, technologies and AI into client solutions.Drive excellence across social media, content, influencer marketing, paid amplification and community engagement.Establish best practices that improve the quality, consistency and effectiveness of digital delivery across teams.Drive Operational ExcellenceOwn the commercial performance of the practice, including forecasting, resourcing and profitability.Ensure high standards of client delivery, operational rigour and execution.Work seamlessly across multidisciplinary teams to deliver best-in-class integrated programs.Who We’re Looking ForWe’re looking for someone who combines digital expertise with commercial thinking and a passion for building integrated communications record of growing client relationships and contributing to business development.Strong commercial acumen and experience managing practice performance.Experience building, mentoring and leading Who are we? Whatfix is an AI platform advancing the “userization” of enterprise applications, empowering companies to maximize the ROI of their digital investments. Technology needs adoption. It’s no different for AI. As AI reshapes roles, workflows, and human-machine interactions, it also introduces new layers of complexity and user friction. This is where Whatfix plays a pivotal role. A decade old DNA of empowering people to succeed with technology and not replacing them. We call this philosophy Userization: the belief that technology must adapt to the user, not the other way around.At the heart of userization philosophy is ScreenSense, our proprietary AI engine, which continuously interprets both the context of what users are doing in an application or an AI tool and the intent behind their actions. By combining these signals, Whatfix delivers real-time guidance, nudges, knowledge, and automation directly in the flow of work.This intelligence powers our entire product suite.Digital Adoption helps users get productive faster. Product Analytics uncovers friction and closes adoption gaps. Mirror allows employees to train in safe, simulated environments. These are embedded with Whatfix AI Agents which supercharge creation, insights, and user guidance.Our upcoming AI-first products are already creating a buzz in the market.Seek is an AI-native assistant that not only knows your business context but can also act across applications to get work done on your behalf. Whatfix Mirror 2.0 is the world’s only System plus Role simulation with a complete assessment to lead the Gen AI simulation category. Together, these products reflect Whatfix’s commitment to building enterprise-ready AI teammates that maximize productivity and ROI. The Customer Success (CS) team are the primary owners of PubMatic’s global publisher base. As an Associate Director, CS in the MidMarket org, you will oversee a team of Team Leads and Customer Success Operations Managers (CSOMs) supporting MidMarket accounts for the US region.We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced team contributor to manage and help build a team that supports the US medium to long-tail publisher business. opportunities and assist in upselling.Work closely with the Advertiser Solutions and Tech Ops teams to create win-win solutions for both the demand and supply side.Oversee Salesforce hygiene and preferred.Minimum 8 years of relevant programmatic ad tech work experience in the digital advertising industry, including in-depth knowledge of areas such as Google AdMob, Google Ad Manager, SSP & DSP relationship management, including excellent service, relationship growth, and cross-sales/upsells.Proactive, quick learner, detail-oriented, strong problem-solving skills.Advanced publisher performance optimization and reporting skills.Very strong analytical thinking abilities, project management, and organization skills.Ability to present clear project plans and communicate with teams to reach desired results.Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) preferred.Ability to work flexible hours (generally local business hours except for meetings that overlap with US (California) mornings).QualificationBCA/B.Tech/B.E./MCA graduation degree or equivalent from a well-known institute/university.Additional InformationReturn to Office: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.Benefits: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, and broadband reimbursement. Director, Customer Success (Regional Leader)Location: Chennai, India | Work Model: In-office (5 days per week)About the TeamOur Chennai Shared Services Center (SSC) is the engine room that powers Appian’s global Customer Success delivery. We are a high-performing, rapidly growing hub of world-class consultants and specialists who enable global enterprise clients to maximize the value of the Appian platform. Our culture thrives on operational excellence, collaboration, and a shared pride in driving tangible business outcomes for our customers worldwide.The OpportunityAs the Director, Customer Success (Regional Leader), you will hold the keys to the overall health, performance, and scalability of our Chennai SSC. This is a pure operational and people leadership role where your success is measured not by technical code, but by organizational vitality- ensuring we have a healthy, optimally staffed, and highly motivated operation. Acting as a critical bridge between local execution and global strategy, you will balance the fast-paced expectations of our US headquarters with the unique needs of our regional talent. If you are an operational strategist who loves building cohesive team cultures, managing global stakeholder matrices, and scaling high-performing regional hubs, this role offers an incredible platform for global impact.What You’ll DoBuild and Scale the Team: Define hiring profiles in collaboration with Capability Leaders and Talent Management, support interviewing, and manage headcount growth to keep supply aligned with the SSC's expanding service portfolio. Proactively keep an eye toward the operational infrastructure needed as the center scales.Set and Uphold the Standard: Establish a culture of excellence and intensity across the Chennai team. Hold consultants to high expectations for quality, accountability, and conduct. Reinforce those standards through performance conversations, recognition, and a consistent, visible leadership presence. Resolve performance issues quickly. Own the Supply Side of the Business: Maintain complete visibility into available capacity across all resource pools and make final consultant assignment decisions in close consultation with Chennai Leaders, who advise on technical readiness, Engagement Managers, who carry the engagement context, and US HQ.Drive Utilization Performance: Monitor and manage billable utilization across the Chennai team as an active, ongoing discipline. Proactively identify underutilization risk. Resolve allocation gaps before they become problems, and hold theater leaders accountable for the pipeline visibility that makes good staffing possible.Govern Regional Finances: Collaborate closely with operations to manage cost tracking, theater charge-backs for unbillable work, and financial discipline across the SSC. Serve as the primary point of contact for Ops finance and ensure the center operates within a clear, defensible cost model.Create and Run Operational Governance: Lead the BAU steering cadence, manage the staffing conflict resolution process, and enforce the lead-time and forecasting expectations that theater leaders must meet. Treat reactive, last-minute staffing requests as a governance issue to be corrected, not an inconvenience to be absorbed.Lead People and Organizational Health: Own the full people management lifecycle for the Chennai team, including performance reviews, career development conversations, compensation inputs, and HR matters. Ensure consultants have the support and clarity they need to grow and stay.Required QualificationsBachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.10+ years of professional experience with a proven track record of leading operations, resource management, or regional hub delivery within a global enterprise software company or top-tier consulting firm.Direct experience working within a US-headquartered organization, with a demonstrated ability to successfully navigate the pace, operating frameworks, and communication style of a US-based matrixed business.Deep expertise in managing resource management metrics, including billable utilization, capacity planning, and operational forecasting.Demonstrated experience in people management, including performance development, compensation planning, and scaling large teams.Strong financial acumen with experience managing regional budgets and internal charge-back models.Ability to work on-site 5 days a week at our Chennai office.Preferred QualificationsMaster of Business Administration (MBA) or equivalent advanced degree in Operations or Management.Experience scaling a Global Capability Center (GCC) or Shared Services Center (SSC) during a phase of rapid growth.Exceptional stakeholder management and conflict resolution skills, with a history of successfully partnering with global executives across different time zones. Tools and Resources Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires. Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.BenefitsAppian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family-forming benefits and more. Benefits vary by country—please ask your Talent Acquisition contact for details specific to the location you are applying to.About AppianAppian provides process automation technology. We automate complex processes in large enterprises and governments. Our platform is known for its unique reliability and scale. We’ve been automating processes for 25 years and understand enterprise operations like no one else. For more information, visit appian.com. You set clear priorities, operating rhythms, and performance expectations for distributed teams. You understand how customer adoption, value realization, risk management, and renewal readiness support retention. You work effectively across Sales, Renewals, Services, Support, Product, and Operations. You are comfortable representing the Customer Success function with customers, prospects, and internal stakeholders. Job Description Head of Digital MarketingIndustry: EdTech (Education Technology)Location: BangaloreReporting To: Vice President Global MarketingPosition Overview We are seeking a visionary and results-driven Head of Digital Marketing to lead a high-growth global EdTech organization into its next phase of expansion and sustained profitability. TutorCloud is a pre-launch. We are an AI native K–12 learning ecosystem entering multiple global markets simultaneously: US, Middle East, India, UK/EU, and Thailand. The product is pedagogy first, compliance ready, and genuinely differentiated in a category flooded with noise. We are not pitching another AI study tool. We are selling integrated learning outcomes to institutions, schools, districts, and chains that have purchase authority, procurement processes, and a real need for something that moves the needle on student outcomes. Your job is to build the performance engine that creates demand, generates qualified pipelines, and converts institutional intent into signed pilots and school contracts. This is a player coach role. You will be running campaigns, not just reviewing them. You will be in pipeline reviews, not just sending dashboards.Key Responsibilities What You Will Own • Full funnel performance marketing strategy and execution across Google Search, LinkedIn, Meta, programmatic, and app channels across all target geographies• Two Regional Performance Managers, one covering US and UK, one covering ME, India, and Thailand, hired, developed, and held accountable by you• Demand generation P&L, with CAC efficiency and pipeline contribution as your primary measures of success• MQL to SQL funnel quality, working closely with sales leadership to tighten ICP targeting, reduce junk rate, and maximise conversion of leads into qualified opportunities• Full attribution and tracking infrastructure: MarTech stack, UTM discipline, regional tracking architecture, CRM hygiene• Weekly pipeline reviews with VP Marketing and sales leadership, shared revenue accountability, not separate marketing reporting• Creative briefing and iteration loop with the Head of Content, ensuring every lost deal informs the next round of creative and messaging• Regional campaign localisation, understanding that the same message does not land the same way in Dubai, Bangalore, and Boston• Ongoing competitive intelligence and channel benchmarking across the K–12 and EdTech landscapeWho You Are • 8 to 12 years of marketing experience spanning both consumers facing brands and enterprise or institutional sales environments. You understand how to drive mass adoption and how to move to a procurement committee• Proven track record in performance marketing across B2C and B2B contexts. You have built funnels that acquire individuals at scale and funnels that generate qualified institutional pipelines. Both are on your records.• Deep hands-on fluency in Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Business Suite, and programmatic platforms, not just oversight• You have worked at a well-regarded consumer internet or tech brand and at a 0 to 1 startup. Both references matter.• Premier institution background preferred, IIM, ISB, or equivalent, or a track record that more than compensates• P&L mindset. You think in unit economics, payback periods, and return on investment, not just platform metrics.• AI native in your approach. You use AI tools to build faster and smarter, not as a replacement for strategic thinking.• You can hold your own in a conversation with a school principal, a district superintendent, or an education chain CTO. Marketing is not behind glass here.What We Offer • A founding team role at a pre-launch AI native K–12 platform, building the performance engine from scratch with real ownership over outcomes• Direct access to the VP Marketing and founding leadership from day one• Competitive compensation with a performance linked structure that grows alongside the company’s commercial trajectory• The chance to build and lead a global team across multiple high-growth markets• A platform to be at the helm of one of the most meaningful AI native growth stories in K–12 education globallyEqual Opportunity Employer We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Applications are welcome from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. We are seeking a metrics-obsessed operator to own the full-funnel expansion of our mobile application environment. As the Head of Growth (App), you will be directly accountable for active app MAU, retention curves, user activation, and premium subscription conversions. You will maintain a direct integration line into the App Product team to unify feature engineering with rigorous growth loops. Key Responsibilities & Core Problems to Solve Build Conversion Funnels: Establish an efficient web-to-app infrastructure that successfully migrates Patrika's high-volume, unowned web traffic into logged-in, highly trackable app users. Solve the Retention Challenge: Redesign user journeys to move away from low-duration "drive-by" visit behaviors, cementing the app as a home for habitual, daily interaction. App Store Discovery Optimization: Drive strategic App Store Optimization (ASO) and user acquisition architectures to compete effectively against premium news application offerings from major regional competitors. Continuous Experimentation: Conduct continuous, small-scale onboarding, push notification, and pricing tests to steadily improve CAC and LTV economics. Experience & Scale Requirements Must have led the growth engine of a consumer app with several million MAU featuring a live subscription or paywall business model. Complete mastery over full-funnel analytics, including onboarding drop-offs, D1/D7/D30 retention analytics, and trial-to-paid conversion metrics. Practical familiarity operating within price-sensitive, low-ARPU emerging markets dominated by payment friction (such as UPI-dependent behaviors). Critical Disqualifiers Growth expertise limited to paid-acquisition-heavy categories (such as gaming or fintech) that bypass structural retention and long-term habit-loop design. No direct exposure to subscription or premium paywall models (having only scaled free, fully ad-supported applications). Inability to address technical Indian Android ecosystem realities, such as optimizing for low-RAM performance, minimizing app download sizes, and navigating data constraints. Pay: ₹3,000,000.00 - ₹3,600,000.00 per year Work Location: In person

Job description:Join us at GPN and inspire people everywhere to achieve their performance and healthy lifestyle goals! At Glanbia Performance Nutrition (GPN), our mission is to inspire people everywhere to achieve their performance and healthy lifestyle goals! We are a global leader in the performance nutrition industry and have a portfolio of nine brands including Optimum Nutrition (ON), BSN and Isopure. Our products are sold in over 130 countries and our brands are in the top three performance nutrition brands in more than 20 countries. Glanbia Performance Nutrition (GPN) is headquartered in Dublin, ROI, with operating facilities in Illinois, California, South Carolina, the UK, the Netherlands, India, Asia and Australia. GPN employs more than 1,800 people globally and has revenues of approximately $1.5B. We are a values led organisation focused on driving sustainable business performance. Join us on our journey now! Head of RGM We are seeking a Head of Revenue Growth Management for driving RGM analytics for pricing, assortment, promotion and trade, drive insights to support RGM strategy-setting for Asia, Middle East and Africa.This role will work with the Commercial functions in ad-hoc requests (e.g., new customer VC, evaluating new promotion) The opportunity where you will make an impact: Work on the AMEA Business Strategy as RGM is a key Business driver Lead revenue analytics - core pricing, assortment analytics (e.g., brand ladders, pack price curves) and promotional analytics for key accounts and across channel archetypes Analyze market trends and create associated reports for key brands and pack sizes Analyze product volume, margin and competitive prices to provide recommendations Provide fact base to assist in determining pricing guidelines on brand/pack/channel level Run analytics to measure trade spend efficiency (e.g., incremental margin or growth per dollar invested in a given account) and make recommended changes Build and update pricing & assortment guidelines Develop promo event-level guidelines and work with Sales to develop ROI-informed promotional calendars/plans Maintain promo effectiveness scorecards Monitor pricing, assortment, promotion and trade execution (e.g., create summary reports & score cards) and participate in regular reviews Monitor and provide consolidated view of competitor activities Partner with Sales & Marketing to develop customer sell-in stories when needed Db ROI annual exercise Channel wise value chain Performance marketing ROI Business case for Retailer Investments What you will bring to GPN: 10+ years experience within finance or commercial. Broad multi-channel experience preferably in established FMCG industry Strong strategic mindset with deep understanding of commercial and financial drivers Experience leading pricing, promotions, and trade investment strategies Ability to analyze complex datasets and convert insights into actionable business plans Strong leadership and influence skills to drive change across the organization, collaborate cross functionally and feed functions with market trends. Results-oriented approach focused on sustainable growth and profitability Advanced writing and communication skills, and be able to interact and persuade individuals levels senior to him or her, as well as actively participate in meetings and group discussions with individuals from other functions (e.g., Marketing, Sales, Finance) Analytical skills – ability to follow detailed instructions to perform complicated financial analyses, as well as determine basic analyses required to support pricing decisions (e.g., structure the problem, collect data, identify issues and present results) Computer skills – advanced knowledge of Excel, Tableau, and PowerPoint is required CA or MBA is an added bonus Knowledge of SAP Where and how you will workThe opportunity will be based in Gurgaon office with hybrid working arrangements available through our Smart working model which allows you a greater choice in how you work and live, giving you a better work-life balance. What we would like to offer you!The opportunity to develop your career on a global stage, continuous learning through an on-demand learning platform, and a competitive compensation package. normalizedText: Who are we?Whatfix is an AI platform advancing the “userization” of enterprise applications, empowering companies to maximize the ROI of their digital investments. Technology needs adoption. It’s no different for AI. As AI reshapes roles, workflows, and human-machine interactions, it also introduces new layers of complexity and user friction. This is where Whatfix plays a pivotal role. A decade old DNA of empowering people to succeed with technology and not replacing them. We call this philosophy Userization: the belief that technology must adapt to the user, not the other way around.Our upcoming AI-first products are already creating a buzz in the market.Seek is an AI-native assistant that not only knows your business context but can also act across applications to get work done on your behalf.Whatfix Mirror 2.0 is the world’s only System plus Role simulation with a complete assessment to lead the Gen AI simulation category.Together, these products reflect Whatfix’s commitment to building enterprise-ready AI teammates that maximize productivity and ROI. It gives users a unified, intelligent way to find answers across systems, apps, and knowledge silos and helps anyone looking to deliver fast and contextual answers.Whatfix is bridging the gap between rapid technological change and human enablement—ensuring AI is not only embedded but also usable, trusted, and outcome-driven for every employee.At Whatfix, we’re not just making software easier—we’re making AI work for people. The company has seven offices across the US, India, UK, Germany, Singapore, and Australia and a presence across 40+ countries.Customers: 700+ enterprise customers, including 80+ Fortune 500 companies such as Shell, Schneider Electric, and UPS Supply Chain Solutions. Investors: A total of $270 million USD has been raised as yet. Most recently Series E round of $125 Million USD led by Warburg Pincus, with participation from existing investor SoftBank Vision Fund 2. Other investors include Cisco Investments, Eight Roads Ventures (A division of Fidelity Investments), Dragoneer, Peak XV Partners, and Stellaris Venture Partners.Whatfix’s leadership is consistently recognized across top industry analysts and business rankings.Won the 2025 AI Breakthrough Award for the Overall AI-based Analytics Solution of the Year.Only DAP to be recognized as a “Leader” across various DAP reports for the past 5+ years by leading analyst firms like Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and Everest Group.With over 45% YoY sustainable annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, Whatfix is among the “Top 50 Indian Software Companies” as per G2 Best Software Awards.Named a Gartner Customers’ Choice for DAP for the second year in a row (2024 and 2025)—the only vendor in the market to earn this distinction consecutively.We also boast a star rating of 4.6 on G2 Crowd, 4.5 on Gartner Peer Insights, and a super-high CSAT of 99.8%Stevie Award winner in the category (Bronze): Customer Service Department of the Year – Computer Software - 100 or More Employees.Winner of the ISG Paragorn Innovation Award in partnership with Sophos (customer) for the EMEA region and finalist in the Transformation Award category.RemoteTech Breakthrough Awards winner for “Software Asset Management Solution of the Year”Be one of the key Leaders in this awesome journey of building a billion-dollar company!About the roleWhatfix is looking for a strategic, data-driven leader to build and run the operating system behind our Customer Success organisation. As Head of CS Operations & Strategy, you will own the frameworks, tools, processes, and intelligence that enable our CS teams to drive measurable customer outcomes at scale.Reporting directly to senior CS leadership, you will sit at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution, translating business goals into operational playbooks, and surfacing insights that shape how we grow and retain our enterprise customer base globally.Key ResponsibilitiesDesign, strategise and own the CS operating model — including coverage design, segmentation strategy, capacity planning, and headcount modelling across onboarding, adoption, and renewal motions.Build and maintain the CS analytics practice: dashboards, health scoring, churn prediction models, and expansion signals that give CS leaders real-time visibility into portfolio health.Own the CS tech stack (CRM, BI tools), driving adoption, governance, and continuous improvement across the tooling layer.Lead quarterly and annual CS planning cycles, working cross-functionally with Finance, Sales, and Product to align on ARR targets, retention goals, and resource allocation.Define and operationalise customer journey playbooks , from onboarding through renewal and expansion, ensuring consistency across regions and segments.Partner with RevOps and Sales Ops to ensure seamless hand-offs, unified data definitions, and a single source of truth across the customer lifecycle.Drive strategic initiatives such as digital CS motions, scaled customer programmes, and the integration of AI-assisted workflows into the CS delivery model.Act as a trusted thought partner to CS leadership on organisational design, performance management, and go-to-market strategyQualification Criteria0-12+ years of experience in CS Operations, Revenue Operations, or Strategy roles within B2B SaaS.Proven track record of building CS operational infrastructure from the ground up or significantly scaling an existing function.Deep expertise in Salesforce, and BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar) and Excel (or Gsheets)Strong analytical and financial modelling skills; comfortable building business cases and presenting to executive leadership.Experience working with enterprise-segment customers and understanding of complex, multi-stakeholder sales and success cycles.Excellent cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills.Prior experience managing or mentoring a team is strongly preferred.You will stand out ifYou have worked in a Digital Adoption Platform or adjacent category (LMS, ITSM, CRM implementation).You have led a CS Ops function through a hyper growth phase or a pre-IPO/liquidity event.You have built AI-assisted CS workflows or automated customer health triggers atscale.You have experience with global CS operations spanning North America, EMEA, andAPAC.You are comfortable with ambiguity and have strong instincts for prioritisation in a fast-moving environment.Perks & Benefits (India)Best-in-class medical insurance coverageFree lunch & dinner buffetDoorstep cab drop facilityEducation sponsorshipInternal job transfer & global mobility programsScope to represent Whatfix at global eventsWe also provide uncapped incentives, bonus plans and opportunities to employees (especially those in GTM teams) to travel to meet our global customers)Note:We strive to live and breathe our Cultural Principles and encourage employees to demonstrate some of these core values - Customer First; Empathy; Transparency; Fail Fast and scale Fast; No Hierarchies for Communication; Deep Dive and innovate; Trust, Do it as you own it.We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse people because of and not in spite of the differences. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.At Whatfix, we deeply value collaboration, innovation, and human connection. role: Director - Customer Marketing, B2C, India, Creativity & Productivity (C&P)
normalizedText: The opportunityIn this leadership role, you’ll be responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing the India marketing strategy to meet the business’ goals for the Digital route to market covering flagship products like Adobe Photoshop, Firefly and Acrobat. As an innovative marketing leader, with a deep understanding of the Indian market and a passion for driving marketing excellence in a competitive environment, you will shape the future of digital marketing in India and are pivotal to Adobe's continued growth in the Asia Pacific region.What You’ll DoSet the vision and provide strategic marketing leadership for the Creativity & Productivity (C&P) portfolio in India. Develop the marketing strategy, aligning cross-functionally to meet quarterly and annual targets including revenue, conversion, retention and ROMS. Lead content creation for full-funnel marketing campaigns, managing creative agencies. Adapt global strategies to the local market and capitalize on regional opportunities. Build effective relationships with Go-to-Market, Product Marketing Management, Comms, A.com, Corporate Marketing and other functions to ensure the India marketing strategy is aligned and delivered effectively. Set and communicate the cross-functional team’s marketing priorities, adapting and making necessary trade-offs. Mange the marketing budget, working with Corporate and regional PMM to allocate across the product portfolio and manage spend to achieve targets. Lead and develop a high-performing cross-functional team and cultivate a working environment aligned to Adobe’s values. Oversee efforts to enhance and localize the Adobe brand for the India market, ensuring cultural relevance and resonance. Influence the martech/infrastructure used internally to shape the future of Adobe and the industry. Develop strategic partnerships for the C&P business unit in India collaborating with the Corp Partnerships team. Play a key role in quarterly business and marketing reviews, defining the ‘narrative’ for India and influencing the Executive team including the India SVP and Country Manager to again agreement on strategic shifts and trade-offs. Establish meaningful regional targets to measure the effectiveness of marketing programs, gaining agreement from Corporate. Use data analytics and market insights to identify key drivers for growth and optimization. What You Need To SucceedDemonstrated track record of working in a global marketing organization as well as “matrixed” functions to deliver more than double digital growth. Excellent project management skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment, with attention to detail. 20+ years of marketing leadership experience in B2C, in software or a technology related field. Deep understanding of the digital marketing (including social & influencer) and media landscape in India with a customer-first approach. Strong understanding of digital business models and demonstrated impact creating and launching initiatives to drive conversion, paid member value expansion and increase customer engagement and retention. Demonstrated success in fast-paced environments, rapidly anticipating and adapting to shifting priorities with strong project management skills. Excellent leadership skills, showing strength in motivating a team to exceed goals. Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills. Exceptional critical thinking, with the ability to translate market insights into actionable marketing strategies focused on outcomes. Outstanding communication, presentation and negotiation skills (verbal and written) in English. Fluent Hindi. Additional local languages highly desirable. Ability to engage and manage culturally diverse team members cross-functionally. Proven success in influencing executives, VP and/or “C” level. Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field. MBA is preferred. Knowledge of Adobe products desirable. About AdobeAdobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.Let’s Adobe togetherAt Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com or call +1 408-536-3015.AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews.
